rules.notes: This is a redraft league with a small keeper overlay, not a dynasty league. Current-season production, role, health, weekly scoring and replacement value must dominate every decision. Keeper surplus is only a secondary tiebreaker for QB/RB/WR/TE. IDP players are evaluated strictly for current-season redraft value and are not keeper candidates. Keepers retain their face-value draft round in future seasons. A free-agent pickup becomes a Round 7 keeper. Drake Maye is a Round 14 keeper. Future draft picks are tradable and may be used as trade currency. The league uses 1 DL, 1 LB, and 1 DB, with no team-defense slot.

valuation_note: Redraft-first policy: keeper value is informational and only a secondary tiebreaker for QB/RB/WR/TE. It does not feed weekly projections, roster power or projected finish. IDP is redraft-only and receives zero keeper value.
